local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local waypoints={{util.vector3(51328,88064,272.0),util.vector3(50560,88192,152.0),util.vector3(49664,88192,-100),util.vector3(48768,88192,-100),util.vector3(47872,88192,-100),util.vector3(46976,88192,-100),util.vector3(46080,88192,-100),util.vector3(45184,88192,-100),util.vector3(44288,88192,-100),util.vector3(43392,88192,-100),util.vector3(42624,88064,-100),util.vector3(41728,88064,-100),util.vector3(40832,88064,-100)}}
local routeIndex=1
local destination=waypoints[1]
local goal=nil;local path=nil;local index=1;local timer=0;local age=0
local arrived=false;local attempts=0;local stuck=0;local last=self.position
local function distance(a,b) local v=a-b;return math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.y*v.y) end
local function route()
 if Actor.isSwimming(self) then
  path={{self.position,destination}};index=1;goal=destination;print('WineRoute ordinary coastal swim to='..tostring(destination));return
 end
 local delta=destination-self.position
 local ratio=math.min(1,1800/math.max(1,distance(destination,self.position)))
 local candidate=self.position+delta*ratio
 local bounds=Actor.getPathfindingAgentBounds(self)
 local options={{agentBounds=bounds,searchAreaHalfExtents=util.vector3(128,128,300)}}
 local source=nearby.findNearestNavMeshPosition(self.position,options)
 local endpoint=nearby.findNearestNavMeshPosition(candidate,options)
 if not source or not endpoint then
  print('WineRoute aim x=0 y=0');print('WineRoute input=wait');return
 end
 local status,p=nearby.findPath(source,endpoint,{{agentBounds=bounds,destinationTolerance=60}})
 print('WineRoute query status='..tostring(status)..' points='..#p..' candidate='..tostring(candidate))
 attempts=attempts+1;assert(attempts<300,'Original wine route repeatedly failed')
 if #p>1 and distance(p[#p],self.position)>50 then path=p;index=1;goal=p[#p];print('WineRoute path end='..tostring(goal)) else print('WineRoute aim x=0 y=0');print('WineRoute input=wait') end
end
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 timer=timer+dt;age=age+dt;if timer<.1 then return end
 local elapsed=timer;timer=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during genuine wine approach')
 if core.isWorldPaused() or age<3 then return end
 if routeIndex<#waypoints and distance(destination,self.position)<160 then
  routeIndex=routeIndex+1;destination=waypoints[routeIndex];path=nil;stuck=0;print('WineRoute waypoint='..routeIndex)
 end
 local target=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x6752a))
 if arrived or (routeIndex==#waypoints and distance(destination,self.position)<160 ) then
  arrived=true;print('WineRoute aim x=0 y=0');print('WineRoute input=continue')

  print('WineRoute arrived shore-prefix=1 pos='..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
  local aim=self.position+util.vector3(-1000,-300,80);local v=camera.getViewTransform():apply(aim)
  local yaw=math.atan2(v.x,-v.z);local pitch=-math.atan2(v.y,math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.z*v.z))
  if math.abs(yaw)<.025 and math.abs(pitch)<.025 then print('WineRoute facing destination') end
  print(string.format('WineRoute look x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(yaw*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(pitch*256+.5)))))
  return
 end
 if not path then route();return end
 local progress=distance(self.position,last);last=self.position
 if self.controls.movement>0 and progress<1 then stuck=stuck+elapsed else stuck=0 end
 assert(stuck<20,'Original wine approach blocked despite ordinary jumps; inspect real obstacle')
 while index<=#path and distance(path[index],self.position)<55 do index=index+1 end
 if index>#path then path=nil;return end
 local v=path[index]-self.position;local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0));local angle=math.atan2(f.y*v.x-f.x*v.y,f.x*v.x+f.y*v.y)
 print(string.format('WineRoute aim x=%d y=%d point=%d pos=%.2f,%.2f,%.2f distance=%.2f',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(angle*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(-camera.getPitch()*256+.5))),index,self.position.x,self.position.y,self.position.z,distance(destination,self.position)))
 if math.abs(angle)<.04 then print('WineRoute facing') end
 print('WineRoute input='..(stuck>2 and 'jump' or 'continue'))
end}}}}
